title: My Brother Forged Mom’s Will, Took Her $190K Book Collection. So I Let Him Incriminate Himself
description: My brother forged my mother’s will to steal her $190,000 rare book collection and told me I was disinherited. I discovered an email where he tried to sell a signed Wizard of Oz to a dealer, hired a probate attorney, and proved the forgery. Now I run a nonprofit where kids earn those books by reading, and I trademarked a logo with his name crossed out. #ForgedWill #ExecutorFraud #RareBookRevenge
thumb_text: HE FORGED MOM'S WILL. I LET HIM SELL THE EVIDENCE.
pinned_comment: What would you do if your own brother forged your mother's will to steal a $190,000 rare book collection and then tried to sell a signed Wizard of Oz? I'd love to hear if you've faced a similar executor betrayal, share your story in the comments.
